title: デビュー戦の後に・伝説級のるんるん

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright takes the race at her own speed. Despite her slow start, she surges ahead in the end and achieves a good result.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our strategy pays off this time. However, as her trainer, I can't help but feel uncertain about the path ahead if she continues at this leisurely pace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I suggest packing her schedule with races so she can get used to hustling a bit. However, she just shakes her head.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She insists that going at a slow pace suits her better. Instead, she'll comfortably prepare herself to win a G1 race as a tribute to the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We set a goal to race in the G1 Hopeful Stakes. It may be an uphill battle getting ready, but I made up my mind to trust her.
